admission.justification: The handover values, the role duties, the parent relay and notice duties, the refusal remedies and the guarded instruction text together promise one end-to-end chain that no single member states; the top-chat presentation, the downward quoted answer and the permission notice each fail alone.

guarantee: A parented developer-question chain keeps actual-parent-ID routing, separate own-authority recommendations, named permission waits and unchanged quoted answers with receiving-agent ID down to the asker. Parentless or unreachable-parent own-chat recovery remains admitted. Ordinary report returns and generic transport remedies separately use approved live-successor role/task addressing or caller-authorized parent/start guidance without unarchiving; that remedy does not supersede the question channel. The retired wording guard detects its registered obsolete sentences, not every novel semantic contradiction.
title: The developer question chain
